headline: Argentine Agricultural Exports Rise 14.2% Year-to-Date to $47.8 Billion
summary: Data from the Argentine Agro-Industrial Council shows agricultural export revenues grew 14.2% year-to-date to $47.8 billion, even as producers warn real exchange rates remain below multi-year averages.
why: Agricultural exports account for the majority of Argentina's foreign currency inflows and central bank reserve accumulation.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Expanding agricultural export revenues improve trade balance and foreign currency inflows.
